import sys
import math

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    x, y, nn = map(int, data[:3])
    eps = 1e-15
    a = x / y
    ans = 1e6
    n_best = x
    d_best = y
    for i in range(1, nn + 1):
        ii = (x * i) / y
        l = math.floor(ii)
        h = math.ceil(ii)
        gg = l / i
        gh = h / i
        ll = abs(gg - a)
        hh = abs(gh - a)
        if abs(hh - ll) < eps:
            if hh < ans - eps:
                n_best = int(l)
                d_best = i
                ans = hh
        elif hh < ll:
            if hh < ans - eps:
                n_best = int(h)
                d_best = i
                ans = hh
        else:
            if ll < ans - eps:
                n_best = int(l)
                d_best = i
                ans = ll
    print(f"{n_best}/{d_best}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
